set_object_state: set an object state in the simulation regardless of constraints using object handle and state value
get_boolean_action: get a boolean action skill for changing a named state to a target boolean value
can_execute_action: test whether an action can be executed on a specified object and return success or error
try_execute_action: try executing an action on an object by checking feasibility first then applying the state change
get_all_available_boolean_actions: get all available boolean actions for a specified object including their current and target values
